evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. No mention of movers showing up on time or damage concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. Rep quoted Monday or Tuesday at the same rate with no mention of cheaper days or date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep asked 'would you like to go ahead and have us help you with this move either Monday or Tuesday this week?' but did not mention rate lock or no deposit before the ask, and did not wait for a direct yes before pivoting to email send.

top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics details methodically (addresses, floor levels, items, packing needs, parking) and delivered both the No Worries Damage Coverage ($2,000) and On-Time Guarantee with clear fee transparency and the 2.5-hour minimum explained.
coaching_note: Never ask the two-concerns question (movers showing up on time or damage) — this is the primary opener for step 2 and it anchors the entire call to what matters to the customer; without it, you're gathering facts instead of building trust.
